# Lina's BodyTracker journal (p05)

## Day 1 — Sun 2026-10-04
- Welcome screen was clear. Setup let me pick lb + in right away — nice, I'm a lb/in person. Height 66 in, 121.5 lb, 26, female, moderately active (I lift 3-5x/week). Said "Yes" to eating at current intake for 2+ weeks.
- After saving, home shows 121.5 lb already (from my profile?). I wasn't sure if the profile weight counts as a weigh-in, so I also logged 121.5 lb at 06:50 via "+ Weight". First time I tapped the big "Weight" tile it opened a trend chart instead of an entry form — small confusion.
- Nutrition tab defaulted to "maintain". I had to find ⚙ to switch the goal to Gain (0.25%/wk default = ~0.3 lb/wk, fine for a slow lean gain). Target went 2,030 -> 2,150 kcal. Maintenance "2,030 ± 480" — that's a huge range, but it says "Estimated, 0% from your data" so OK.
- Confusion: protein line says "1.6 g/kg × 121.5 lb reference weight" — mixing g/kg with lb is weird to read. Protein settings ask for g per kg; I don't think in kg.
- Confusion: Protein shows "— g / 88 g" even after I logged a 23 g protein breakfast. Maybe it only counts complete days?
- Day total line drops the protein figure once any meal has "no macros" (1184 kcal, no "g protein") — fine, but I lost my protein running total.
- **Late-night snack (00:40 on Mon 10-05, cereal/chips 299 kcal):** I expected it to go on Sunday 10-04 ("tonight"). The Food log opened on **2026-10-05** by default, so it landed on **10-05**. I noticed because the screen said "Nothing logged for this day yet" and my day total was only 299.
  - At 00:40 the app also showed a banner "Mark yesterday (2026-10-04) complete?" — awkward timing: I was literally about to eat something that belongs to yesterday. If I'd tapped "Yes" I'd have closed the day before logging the snack.
  - Tried to fix with Edit: the Edit form has no date field. Changing the Date at the top while editing just silently cancelled the edit. Had to delete the 10-05 entry and re-add it on 10-04. Workable, but clunky at 1 a.m. Final: snack on **10-04** (after my fix); day total 2,097; marked 10-04 complete.
  - Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p05/screens/1790454700240.png (entry sitting on 10-05)

## Day 2 — Mon 2026-10-05
- Weighed 123.0 lb (up 1.5 — water/pizza, whatever). Trend 121.7.
- Logged all meals with macros; day total with macros shows nicely.
- **Late-night snack 00:40 (Tue 10-06), 195 kcal:** Food log again opened on **2026-10-06**. This time I knew, so I changed the date to 10-05 before adding. Ended up on **10-05** (what I expected, but only because I fixed the date by hand). Then answered the "Mark yesterday (2026-10-05) complete?" banner with Yes.
- Protein now shows 133 g / 88 g "average of 1 complete day(s) with protein logged". So day 1 didn't count for protein because the shawarma had no macros? Slightly confusing but OK.
- "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" still says day 1 — I guess it's frozen until the weekly update.

## Day 3 — Tue 2026-10-06
- 122.8 lb. Logged all 4 meals.
- **Late-night snack 00:40 (Wed 10-07), 193 kcal:** I was sleepy and just logged it — the form defaulted to **2026-10-07**, so it landed on **10-07**. Expected 10-06. Then the "Mark yesterday (2026-10-06) complete?" banner was right there and I tapped Yes — so 10-06 got marked complete at 1,794 kcal WITHOUT my snack, and the average intake went into the stats wrong (2,068).
- Next morning (day 4, 07:35) when I opened the food log for breakfast, 10-07 already showed "193 kcal · Late snack" — that's how I caught it. Deleted it, switched date to 10-06 and re-added (10-06 stayed ☑ complete, total now 1,987). Avg intake corrected to 2,133.
- Wish: after midnight the app should either default to "yesterday" or at least ask "Is this for tonight (Tue) or Wed?". Also the "Mark yesterday complete" banner appearing at 00:40 invites closing the day too early for night owls.
- Screenshot of the wrong state: tests/personas/run3/out/p05/screens/1790454822736.png

## Day 4 — Wed 2026-10-07
- 122.6 lb. No late snack tonight. Logged all meals, marked the day complete myself at 23:30 via the Day complete box.

## Day 5 — Thu 2026-10-08
- 122.6 lb. Two meals without macros (oats, mandi) — day total shows kcal only.
- **Late-night snack 00:40 (Fri 10-09), 237 kcal:** form defaulted to **2026-10-09** again; I switched it to 10-08 by hand. Landed on **10-08** (expected). Then Yes on the "mark yesterday complete" banner.
- Found the "Last 14 days" list at the bottom of Nutrition — really useful for checking which day things landed on (10-08: 5 entries, 2,536, complete). It also shows "Today not logged" at 00:40, meaning it considers "today" = 10-09 already.
- "Carbs ~341 g / fat ≥48 g" appeared — no idea where those targets come from, but fine.

## Day 6 — Fri 2026-10-09
- 122.8 lb. No late snack. Marked complete at 23:45.
- Noticed in Body > Recent entries there are TWO weigh-ins on 2026-10-04 at 121.5 lb — the profile setup apparently created one, and I added my own. Nothing told me the profile weight gets saved as a weigh-in. Harmless (same number) but messy. Screenshot: tests/personas/run3/out/p05/screens/1790454960680.png

## Day 7 — Sat 2026-10-10
- Didn't weigh. No late snack. Logged all, marked complete.
- Opened "Explain the math". Way too much math for me (Kalman filter, Hall 2008, MAD…), but I liked that it says clearly: 7/7 days complete, 6 weigh-ins used, formula 2,027 kcal. It estimated my body fat at 24.1% "from BMI" — I'm pretty lean so that's probably high, but it says it's an estimate.

## Week 1 (checked Sat 10-10, before the Sunday update)
- App says: maintenance **2,030 ± 480 kcal/day**, label **Estimated** (0% from my data), target **2,150 kcal/day** (gain 0.25%/wk). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,150 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data." No warnings. Body composition: "Not enough data yet".
- My avg intake over complete days is around 2,250. So I'm already eating a bit above the suggested 2,150, which for a slow gain seems fine. Weight went 121.5 -> ~122.8 but trend only 122.0.
- Decision: no change yet, the app itself says it needs more data. Keep eating as I do.

## Days 8–14 (scripted routine, still tapping through the app)
- Routine: weigh 06:50, log 4 meals at meal times, mark day complete at 23:45 or via the 00:40 "Mark yesterday complete?" banner.
- Late snacks this week: day 8 (Sun 10-11) and day 13 (Fri 10-16). Both times the food log opened on the NEXT date (10-12, 10-17); I changed the date by hand before adding, so they landed on 10-11 and 10-16 (confirmed in "Last 14 days": 10-11 5 entries 2,069; 10-16 5 entries 2,099). Every single time I have to remember to change the date.
- Weight dipped: 123 -> 119.7–120.6 lb. For someone trying to gain that's annoying.
- On Sat (day 14) the screen still showed "+0.64 lb/week" from last Sunday even though my scale had been down for days — because numbers only refresh Sundays. I get why, but it looked stale.

## Week 2 (Sun 10-18 update)
- Maintenance **2,260 ± 400** (Estimated, 29% from my data), target **2,380** kcal/day (gain 0.25%/wk = +0.30 lb/wk).
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.13 to +0.88 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30 lb/week. Suggested intake: 2,380 kcal/day."
- 14-day rate shows **−0.13 lb/week**. Confusing: it says "On track" while my weight is actually going slightly DOWN and I want to gain. I guess "the range includes the target" = on track, but that range is so wide that almost anything would be "on track".
- Avg intake 2,194. Protein 121 g vs 88 g target — good.
- Decision: follow the suggestion, eat ~2,380 from tomorrow (plan 2380). I want to gain, not lose.

## Days 15–21
- Late snacks: day 15 (Sun 10-18): form defaulted to 10-19, I changed it -> landed 10-18. Day 20 (Fri 10-23): I was tired and didn't change the date -> it landed on **10-24** and I then tapped Yes on "Mark yesterday (2026-10-23) complete?" — so Friday was closed without the snack. Next morning at breakfast I saw "Late snack" already sitting on Saturday, deleted it and re-added on 10-23 (now 5 entries, 2,604). Third time this has happened to me.
- Weights bounced 120.4–123 lb; trend basically flat around 121.2.

## Week 3 (Sun 10-25 update)
- Maintenance **2,250 ± 330**, now labelled **Measured** (53% from my data). Target **2,370** kcal/day.
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.79 to +0.83 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30 lb/week. Suggested intake: 2,370."
- 14-day rate **+0.02 lb/week**, avg intake 2,372. So I'm eating exactly the target and basically not gaining. The app still says "On track". As someone who wants to gain 0.3 lb/wk, +0.02 doesn't feel on track to me — it feels like "maintaining". I'd rather it said "you're below your target rate, but it's too early to be sure".
- Body tab: body composition still "Not enough data yet" (I never entered body fat, so fair).
- Decision: already eating ~2,380 which matches the suggestion; no change. Give it another week.

## Days 22–28
- Late snacks: day 23 (Mon 10-26): default 10-27, changed -> landed 10-26. Day 25 (Wed 10-28): forgot, landed **10-29**; I'd already tapped Yes on "Mark yesterday (10-28) complete?". Fixed next morning (delete + re-add; 10-28 now 5 entries, 2,572). Day 28 (Sat 10-31, Halloween): default 11-01, changed -> landed 10-31 (3,209, big day).

## Week 4 (Sun 11-01 update)
- Maintenance **2,260 ± 270** (Measured, 68% from my data). Target **2,380**.
- Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.27 to +1.08 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30 lb/week. Suggested intake: 2,380 kcal/day."
- 14-day rate **+0.41 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,527 (above target). The ± on maintenance keeps shrinking (480 -> 400 -> 330 -> 270), which makes me trust it more.
- Decision: re-commit to ~2,380/day (plan 2380) since I'm gaining a bit faster than I want.

## Days 29–35
- Late snacks: day 29 (Sun 11-01, the night the clocks went back): default 11-02, changed -> landed 11-01. Day 32 (Wed 11-04): default 11-05, changed -> landed 11-04. The app's default never changes: after midnight it always picks the new calendar day.
- Scale 120.2–122.8 lb, trend ~121.4.

## Week 5 (Sun 11-08 update)
- New banner: "It's been 30+ days since your last backup… Back up now | Later". I tapped Back up now -> "Your data" screen (32 weigh-ins, 153 food entries, 35 complete days, "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser") -> Full backup (JSON) downloaded bodytracker-backup-2026-11-08.json. Good nudge.
- Maintenance **2,330 ± 230** (Measured, 77%). Target **2,450**. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.40 to +0.75 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30 lb/week. Suggested intake: 2,450 kcal/day."
- 14-day rate **+0.18 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,266 (I undershot my 2,380 plan).
- Decision: follow it, eat ~2,450 (plan 2450).

## Days 36–42
- Late snacks on 11-08, 11-09, 11-11, 11-14: every time the form defaulted to the next day (11-09, 11-10, 11-12, 11-15) and I changed it by hand; all landed on the right day. It's become muscle memory but it's still an extra step at 1 a.m. every night.
- Scale 119.3–122.1 lb.

## Week 6 (Sun 11-15 update)
- Maintenance **2,370 ± 190** (Measured, 84%). Target **2,490**. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.45 to +0.52 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30. Suggested intake: 2,490."
- 14-day rate **+0.04 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,420.
- My read: six weeks in, my trend went 121.5 -> ~121.3. Basically zero gain. Every week the app nudges maintenance up (2,030 -> 2,260 -> 2,250 -> 2,260 -> 2,330 -> 2,370) and the target up with it, and every week it says "On track". I'm starting to feel "On track" is just what it always says. For a gain goal, +0.04 vs +0.30 target should at least be a "slightly below target" message.
- Decision: eat ~2,500 (plan 2500), a touch above the suggestion.

## Days 43–49
- Late snacks 11-15 and 11-21: form defaulted to 11-16 / 11-22; changed by hand -> landed correctly.
- Ate more than planned most days (2,4xx–3,1xx). Scale jumped to 123.5–123.7 lb mid-week.

## Week 7 (Sun 11-22 update)
- Maintenance **2,370 ± 200** (Measured, 82%). Target **2,490**. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.87 to +2.14 lb/week) includes your target of +0.30. Suggested intake: 2,490."
- 14-day rate **+0.64 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,808.
- NEW warning: "2026-11-17: macros add up to ~1961 kcal vs 2381 kcal logged (18% apart). One of the numbers may be off." I typed exactly what my food apps said (yogurt & granola 693 kcal but only 24P/76C/19F, etc.) — so the labels are inconsistent, not me. Nice catch actually, but it doesn't tell me which entry is off or let me tap to go there.
- "On track" again — even though now I'm gaining at 2x my target. So it said "On track" at −0.13, +0.02, +0.04 and +0.64. The range is so wide (−0.87 to +2.14) that everything is "on track".
- Decision: pull back to ~2,490 (plan 2490).

## Days 50–56
- Late snacks 11-23 and 11-24: form defaulted to the next day again; changed by hand -> landed right.
- Thanksgiving week. Scale 122.6–124.1 lb.

## Week 8 (Sun 11-29 update)
- Maintenance **2,360 ± 210** (Measured, 80%). Target **2,490** (+0.31 lb/wk). Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.60 to +2.64 lb/week) includes your target of +0.31. Suggested intake: 2,490."
- 14-day rate **+1.02 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,479. Scale this morning 124.3 lb (started at 121.5).
- This is where "On track" really bugs me: I'm gaining 3x faster than my target and it still shows the same green "On track". A range of −0.60 to +2.64 lb/week is useless for decisions. I'd want "you're gaining faster than planned, consider ~X kcal".
- Decision: I'm overriding it and trimming to ~2,400 (plan 2400). Probably partly Thanksgiving water/salt, but I'd rather be careful.

## Days 57–63
- Late snacks: day 57 (Sun 11-29): default 11-30, changed -> 11-29 OK. Day 60 (Wed 12-02): tired, forgot -> landed on **12-03**, and I'd already said Yes to "Mark yesterday (2026-12-02) complete?". Caught it at breakfast, deleted it from 12-03 and re-added on 12-02 (2,097 total). Fourth time this has happened to me in 9 weeks.
- Scale 121.7–125.0 lb.

## Week 9 (Sun 12-06 update)
- Maintenance **2,370 ± 220** (Measured, 78%). Target **2,500**. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.34 to +0.65 lb/week) includes your target of +0.31. Suggested intake: 2,500."
- 14-day rate **−0.34 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,287. I over-corrected. And it's "On track" again, now while I'm losing.
- Decision: back to ~2,500 (plan 2500).

## Days 64–70
- Late snacks 12-07, 12-08, 12-09: form defaulted to 12-08, 12-09, 12-10; I changed each by hand -> all landed on the right evening.
- Scale 121.0–123.7 lb.

## Week 10 (Sun 12-13 update)
- Backup reminder again ("30+ days") -> backed up (bodytracker-backup-2026-12-13.json). Wait, my last backup was 11-08, which is 35 days, OK fair.
- Maintenance **2,360 ± 230** (Measured, 77%). Target **2,480**. Recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−1.36 to +0.58 lb/week) includes your target of +0.31. Suggested intake: 2,480."
- Macro warning again: "2026-12-12: macros add up to ~1685 kcal vs 2243 kcal logged (25% apart)".
- 14-day rate **−0.39 lb/wk** while my avg intake was **2,572** — above the target. That doesn't add up for me: eating more than "target" yet the rate is negative? Probably the drop from my 125 lb Thanksgiving high. The app still says "On track".
- Decision: stay at the suggested ~2,480 (plan 2480).

## Days 71–77
- Late snacks 12-13, 12-14, 12-15, 12-18: default always the next date; changed by hand -> correct. Day 74 (Wed 12-16): forgot -> landed **12-17**; had already said Yes to "Mark yesterday (2026-12-16) complete?"; caught at breakfast, deleted + re-added on 12-16 (2,956). Fifth time.
- Holiday season, eating more; scale up to 126.5 lb.

## Week 11 (Sun 12-20 update)
- Maintenance **2,270 ± 210** (Measured, 81%). Target **2,390**.
- Recommendation (first time it's NOT "On track"!): "Your estimated rate (+0.44 to +1.51 lb per week) doesn't include your target of +0.31 lb/week. Eating about 270 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,390."
- 14-day rate **+0.98 lb/wk**, avg intake 2,657.
- This is exactly the kind of message I wanted weeks ago. Clear number, clear action.
- Decision: follow it, ~2,390 (plan 2390).

## Days 78–84
- Late snacks 12-20, 12-23, 12-24, 12-26: form defaulted to the next day each time; changed by hand -> correct.
- Scale 124.8–125.9 lb.

## Week 12 (update ran at 00:40 on Sun 12-27, right after my last snack)
- Maintenance **2,280 ± 210** (Measured, 80%). Target **2,400**. Recommendation: back to "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.59 to +2.21 lb/week) includes your target of +0.31. Suggested intake: 2,400." 14-day rate +0.81, avg intake 2,340.
- Odd: the "Sunday" update ran at 00:40 Sunday — for me that's still Saturday night. It even computed "6 of last 7 days complete" with Sunday counted as not logged.
- Decision: would keep ~2,400.

## End tasks
- ⇩ -> "Your data": Full backup (JSON) -> downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-27.json. Daily data export, All data, with individual food entries -> downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. Also Food CSV -> downloads/bodytracker-food-2026-12-27.csv.
- Opened them: all 35 late snacks are on the evening I meant (because I fixed every one by hand). Food entries carry no time, so nothing shows they were eaten after midnight.
- Daily export is **kg/cm only** ("in kg, cm, kcal and g"), even though I set lb/in everywhere. 55.1 kg means nothing to me. The backup stores weights like 55.111472955.
- 10-04 has two weigh-ins in the export (06:50 mine and 07:00 from the profile setup).

## Final review
The logging itself is quick, and I love the "Last 14 days" list and the maintenance ± getting narrower week by week (480 -> 210). But as a night owl the date thing drove me nuts. Every single one of my 35 midnight snacks opened on the NEXT day's date. I had to change it by hand every night, and the 5 times I forgot, the snack landed on the wrong day. Worse, the "Mark yesterday complete?" banner is sitting right there at 00:40, so I closed my evening before the snack was on it, and only found the mistake at breakfast. Moving an entry means delete + re-add, because Edit has no date field. The recommendation said "On track" in 10 of the 11 weekly checks, whether I was at −0.34 or +1.02 lb/week, so I stopped trusting it until it finally said "eat ~270 less" in week 11. Exports ignore my lb setting. Would keep using: maybe. Yes, if it handled "tonight after midnight" properly.

# p05 (Lina, 26, NYC, night owl, lb/in, slow lean gain): final report

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 of 84 days (2026-10-04 to 2026-12-26).
- Meals logged: 371 food entries, including 35 after-midnight snacks.
- Days marked complete: 84 of 84.
- Weigh-ins: 78 days (79 entries, because profile setup silently added a duplicate 10-04 weigh-in).
- Backups: 3 full backups (11-08, 12-13, 12-27), plus a daily export and a Food CSV at the end.

## 2. Weekly table
| week | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (10-04 update, seen 10-10) | 2,030 ± 480 | 2,150 | Estimated (0%) | Suggested 2,150; on-track check needs 14 days | no change |
| 2 (10-18) | 2,260 ± 400 | 2,380 | Estimated (29%) | On track (rate −0.13); 2,380 | plan 2380 |
| 3 (10-25) | 2,250 ± 330 | 2,370 | Measured (53%) | On track (+0.02); 2,370 | kept ~2,380 |
| 4 (11-01) | 2,260 ± 270 | 2,380 | Measured (68%) | On track (+0.41); 2,380 | plan 2380 |
| 5 (11-08) | 2,330 ± 230 | 2,450 | Measured (77%) | On track (+0.18); 2,450; backup nudge | backed up; plan 2450 |
| 6 (11-15) | 2,370 ± 190 | 2,490 | Measured (84%) | On track (+0.04); 2,490 | plan 2500 |
| 7 (11-22) | 2,370 ± 200 | 2,490 | Measured (82%) | On track (+0.64); macro mismatch warning for 11-17 | plan 2490 |
| 8 (11-29) | 2,360 ± 210 | 2,490 | Measured (80%) | On track, although the rate was +1.02 | overrode it: plan 2400 |
| 9 (12-06) | 2,370 ± 220 | 2,500 | Measured (78%) | On track (−0.34); 2,500 | plan 2500 |
| 10 (12-13) | 2,360 ± 230 | 2,480 | Measured (77%) | On track (−0.39); macro warning for 12-12; backup nudge | backed up; plan 2480 |
| 11 (12-20) | 2,270 ± 210 | 2,390 | Measured (81%) | Not on track (+0.44 to +1.51): eat ~270 less, 2,390 | plan 2390 |
| 12 (12-27) | 2,280 ± 210 | 2,400 | Measured (80%) | On track (+0.81); 2,400 | would keep ~2,400 |

## 3. After-midnight snacks: where each one landed
- **Every one of the 35 snacks** logged at 00:40 opened the Food log on the **next calendar date**, never the evening I meant. Examples: 10-04 → 10-05, 11-01 → 11-02, 12-26 → 12-27.
- **29 times** I changed the date by hand before adding. The snack landed on the evening I meant.
- **Once** (day 1, 10-04) it first landed on 10-05. I moved it back to 10-04 the same night by deleting it and adding it again.
- **5 times** I was sleepy and forgot. Each time I then tapped Yes on "Mark yesterday complete?", so that evening was closed without its snack:

| evening I meant | where it landed | when I caught it |
|---|---|---|
| 10-06 | 10-07 | next breakfast |
| 10-23 | 10-24 | next breakfast |
| 10-28 | 10-29 | next breakfast |
| 12-02 | 12-03 | next breakfast |
| 12-16 | 12-17 | next breakfast |

- After all my fixes, the final export has all 35 snacks on the evening I meant.
- The full per-snack list is in `tests/personas/run3/out/p05/snacks.csv`.

## 4. Confusions
- **Nutrition:** the goal defaults to "maintain". I had to find ⚙ to choose Gain.
- **Protein line:** it reads "1.6 g/kg × 121.5 lb reference weight", mixing kg and lb. The protein setting is in g per kg.
- **Protein total:** "— g" showed even after I logged protein. It is an average over complete days where every entry has protein, and nothing said so.
- **Day total:** it silently drops the protein figure once any entry has no macros.
- **Body tab:** tapping the big Weight tile opened a chart, not the entry form.
- **Profile setup:** it created a weigh-in without telling me, which gave me a duplicate on 10-04.
- **Recommendation:** it said "On track" at rates of −0.34, +0.02, +0.04, +0.64 and +1.02 lb/week against a +0.30 target. The range was so wide that "On track" meant nothing to me.
- **Mid-week numbers:** they stay frozen until Sunday. On Saturday of week 2 it still showed +0.64 lb/week while my scale had been down for days.
- **Macro mismatch warning:** useful, but it doesn't say which entry is off and doesn't link to it.
- **Weekly update timing:** it ran at 00:40 on Sunday, which is still Saturday night for me.
- **Daily export:** it is in kg/cm even though I chose lb/in.

## 6. Review
Logging is fast. The "Last 14 days" list and the maintenance ± shrinking every week (480 → 210) made me trust the numbers. But as someone who snacks after midnight, I had to fix the date on every one of 35 snacks, and the 5 times I forgot, the snack landed on the wrong day. The "Mark yesterday complete?" banner makes that worse, because it closes the evening before the snack is on it. The weekly advice said "On track" in 10 of 11 checks whatever my scale did, so it only really helped once, in week 11.

**Would keep using: maybe.** Yes, if it understood that 00:40 is still "tonight".
